sn12.38:1.2: Yañca kho bhikkhave ceteti yañ ca pakappeti yañca anuseti || ārammaṇam etaṃ hoti viññāṇassa ṭhitiyā ||
sn12.38:1.4: tasmiṃ patiṭṭhite viññāṇe virūḷhe āyatim punabbhavābhinibbatti hoti ||
sn12.38:1.5: āyatim punabbhavābhinibbattiyā sati āyatiṃ jarāmaraṇaṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā sambhavanti || ||
sn12.38:1.6: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti || || 3
sn12.38:2.1: No ce bhikkhave ceteti no ce pakappeti atha ce anuseti || ārammaṇam etaṃ hoti viññāṇassa ṭhitiyā ||
sn12.38:2.3: tasmiṃ patiṭṭhite viññāṇe virūḷhe āyatiṃ punabbhavābhinibbatti hoti ||
sn12.38:2.4: āyatiṃ punabbhavābhinibbatiyā sati āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇaṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā sambhavanti ||
sn12.38:2.5: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti || || 4
sn12.38:3.1: Yato ca kho bhikkhave no ceva ceteti no ca pakappeti no ca anuseti || ārammaṇam etaṃ na hoti viññāṇassa ṭhitiyā ||
sn12.38:3.2: ārammaṇe asati patiṭṭhā viññāṇassa na hoti ||
sn12.38:3.3: tad appatiṭṭhite viññāṇe avirūḷhe āyatiṃ punabbhavābhinibbatti na hoti ||
sn12.38:3.4: āyatiṃ punabbhavābhinibbattiyā asati āyatiṃ jāti jarāmaraṇam sokadevaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā nirujjhanti ||
sn12.38:3.5: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa nirodho hotī ti || ||
